title: ‘Awards Chatter’ Pod: EJAE on Her ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Hit “Golden,” New Single “Time After Time” and Feeling “Very Nervous” About the Oscars
summary: In front of an audience at Chapman University, the co-writer/performer of the first K-pop song to ever win a Grammy reflects on how it emerged after she was told she would never become a K-pop idol: "I wasn't a good enough singer, I wasn't a good enough dancer, I was way too old, and I was also too tall."
